positioning.subtitle: DROS is not a replacement for existing security tools — it is a new category: AI Agent Runtime Governance. The table below clarifies each technology's defense layer and capability scope for accurate selection and Defense-in-Depth deployment.

positioning.footnote: 📌 Complementary Relationship Notice: Confidential Computing (Intel TDX / Azure Confidential VM) and DROS protect different attack surfaces and are complementary, not competing. Confidential Computing defends the infrastructure layer (preventing cloud operators and hypervisors from reading TEE memory); DROS defends the AI Agent runtime application layer (preventing Agent privilege escalation and Prompt Injection exfiltration). Both can be deployed simultaneously for Defense-in-Depth. Data Clean Rooms are designed for offline batch multi-party analytics; API Gateways handle traffic control — neither is designed for real-time AI Agent runtime behavioral governance.

espr.desc: EU Cross-Border Supply Chain Carbon Passport Zero-Knowledge Shield. Resolves the trade-off between EU ESPR (DPP) transparency mandates and proprietary BOM secret exfiltration! Produces verifiable carbon proofs.
espr.details:
🎯 Target Regulations: EU ESPR 2024/1781, EU CBAM, ISO 14040/44 LCA Carbon Standards

🛡️ Core Mechanisms

  • In-Band Zero-Knowledge Field Redaction: 14+ proprietary BOM fields (baking temperatures, material costs, formulation ratios) are physically overwritten in memory before TCP packet assembly — they never leave the server.
  • Verifiable Carbon Proof Output: Only SHA-256 signed aggregate CO2e values and CBAM-compliant certificate IDs are returned. EU auditors can independently verify without accessing raw manufacturing data.
  • Scope-Declarative Authorization Matrix: vajra_policy.yaml statically declares permitted/prohibited field access. Compiled to binary lookup at build time — no regex, no runtime string matching.
  • HITL Dual-Signature Gate: High-risk queries (e.g. full BOM export attempts) auto-trigger human approval flow; requests remain suspended until plant manager signs off.

📦 Includes: ESPR Compliance VEP Control Panel UI Template + vajra_policy.yaml Carbon Passport Redaction Rules + Installation README
